title: fix: drop promo code field so checkout has no dead end
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Removed `allow_promotion_codes` from Pollen pack checkout sessions. Stripe checkout and the saved-card pay window no longer offer a promotion-code field when there are no codes to use. Quest Pollen codes are unaffected.

Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream backdrop, dark purple (#110518) outlines, and chunky retro sprites.
